text:
maria (Partnerships): Quick sync — pulling together vendor timelines and announcement windows for H100/H200, MI300, and Gaudi. Want to align marketplace listings, pilot capacity, and a joint announcement cadence. Who's here from the vendor side?

nvidia-biz: here. TL;DR: H200 availability target week of 2026-06-08; pilot capacity we can commit starting 2026-06-15. We have an embargoed media window we prefer around 2026-06-22.

amd-partner: MI300 roadmap: customer preview late June, GA mid-July. Marketplace packaging needs to be finalized by ~2026-07-05 for our marketplace catalog sync. Embargo can be adjusted if Redwood needs earlier sync.

habana-sales: Gaudi hardware is available for select SI partners earlier — we can support validation starting 2026-06-01. Suggest aligning any public announcement with a published validation report.

alex (Platform): From Redwood's side we want the joint press window between 2026-06-22 and 2026-07-10. Requirements: perf numbers (p99 latency, throughput), a short performance profile, and an agreed 2-3 sentence press blurb. Also need certified container images and supported driver matrix.

jin (Eng-ML): For runtime compatibility we need exact driver/ROCm/CUDA versions, model vetting profiles, and preferred quantization configs. Can vendors share test vectors and a small validation harness? For MI300 specifically, what ROCm version should we target?

amd-partner: Target ROCm 6.5 for the preview; we'll confirm patch-level. We'll also push certified containers and test vectors to a vendor registry and give Redwood access.

sophie (Product): Marketplace checklist we need: logo + brand asset, SKU name, deploy scripts (Helm/CloudFormation), minimum instance footprint, supported kernels & driver versions, and suggested pricing placeholder. Who owns the marketplace tile/asset on Redwood side? @maria?

maria (Partnerships): I can own the marketplace tile. I'll gather assets. Deadline request: assets by 2026-06-30 so Product can draft the listing.

nvidia-biz: We'll provide an embargoed slide deck and microbenchmarks. Can Redwood sign an NDA for early deck review? Link: https://redwood.example/nda-draft (internal-only).

maria (Partnerships): Confirmed — legal looped in. @sophie please flag any language that needs legal review.

sophie (Product): Will route to legal; aiming for sign-off by 2026-06-12 so we can ingest deck and finalize blurb.

jin (Eng-ML): QA/test matrix proposal (quick example):
```
# validation-matrix
models: [gpt-small, gpt-medium]
seq-lens: [512, 2048, 8192]
batching: [1, 8, 32]
quant-modes: [fp16, int8, q4_0]
metrics: [p99_latency_ms, tokens_per_sec, mem_util_pct]
```
Please vendor-provide expected baselines for each device so we can sanity check.

habana-sales: We'll contribute validation reports and a short runbook for SI deployments. Also proposing a shared CS plan for early customers — weekly 30-min sync starting 2026-06-20 to triage validation.

alex (Platform): Ops question: can vendors reserve pilot capacity in us-west-2 for Redwood Dedicated for 2026-06-15 through 2026-07-31? We need node counts and cost estimates to confirm commit levels.

nvidia-biz: Yes, we can reserve pilot nodes; we'll need a short PO/commit template from Redwood. We'll attach cost estimates by 2026-06-05.

amd-partner: We'll mirror for MI300. Please confirm desired node count by 2026-06-10 (so we can calendar & provision).

maria (Partnerships): Action items summary (owners + due dates):
- Vendor assets & embargo deck -> vendors -> 2026-06-12
- Legal sign-off on NDA/press language -> sophie -> 2026-06-12
- Marketplace assets (logos/one-liner/tiles) -> vendors -> 2026-06-30
- Pilot node counts & PO template -> alex -> confirm to vendors -> 2026-06-10
- Validation test vectors & expected baselines -> vendors -> 2026-06-08
- Weekly CS sync for SI validations -> habana-sales/maria -> start 2026-06-20

Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree to these owners/dates or reply with corrections. We'll set a follow-up sync Weds afternoon to finalize press copy.

deploy-bot: Reminder: #partnerships scheduled follow-up meeting created for 2026-06-09 15:00 PDT — invite sent.

amd-partner: :thumbsup: we'll aim to deliver containers + validation artifacts by 06/08.

nvidia-biz: Acknowledged. We'll send PO template and embargoed deck link by EOD.

habana-sales: We'll provide validation report sample and join the weekly CS calls.

alex (Platform): I'll draft the PO template and capacity ask by 2026-06-05.

maria (Partnerships): Great — thanks everyone. If anything slips, ping this thread. We'll capture final announcement window after legal & asset sign-off. :rocket:
